rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Classroom = default delivery; body teaches work, trainer manages room.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Mood contract named.

Trace mood 8/8/8, close 8 (trace.phases[0..2].mood_score, trace.close.mood_score). Closest to floor: phase 1 sting at a favourite branch marked stretched (L15-19), 8 and intended. All three phases are teaching beats; none is setup. Take stock L47 is 'settled but not tidy: the bet can still lose', does not preempt the next piece.

L47 'the branches you set aside still on the board'. Unease is about what the evidence supports, not what the team did wrong.
